lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Primary cluster of high-intensity circular local maxima concentrated in the mid-lateral zone posterior to the branchial slits, forming a non-linear grid across approximately 40% of the visible flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs to form a visible lattice, most prominent in the dorso-lateral region of the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A continuous horizontal feature exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient (luminance high on dorsal side, low on ventral side) extending from the posterior gill slits toward the caudal peduncle.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-to-moderate density of discrete high-luminance blobs distributed across the lateral surface of the visible first dorsal fin mask.

other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast spotting pattern visible on the dorsal surface of the primary pectoral fin; presence of multiple low-luminance elongated objects (likely commensal teleosts) ventral to the main body silhouette.
